Using SWOT or PESTLE in a business assignment? A list of bullet points is description. Markers want analysis 📊

✅ Sort it right: if the company controls it, it is a strength or weakness. If not, it is an opportunity or threat
✅ Use evidence, not generic points like "good customer service"
✅ Cut each list to the factors that matter most and explain why
✅ Let PESTLE feed your opportunities and threats
✅ Finish with strategy: a TOWS matrix turns your SWOT into options

Writing your dissertation methodology? The key word is justification 🧭

Saying "I used interviews" earns few marks. Explaining why interviews were the best way to answer your question is what lifts the chapter.

Avoid these common mistakes:
❌ Listing every research philosophy instead of choosing one
❌ Mismatched layers, like positivism with a small qualitative sample
❌ Future tense left over from your proposal
❌ Ethics in a single sentence
❌ Hiding your limitations

Free guide with the research onion and a sample paragraph: fizbusinessolutions.com/blog/dissertation-methodology-guide
